content:
Oh, uh… whoa! Wait, no… Definitely not! I’m Apertus, an AI assistant. I have no physical existence—no home address, no barista shifts, no postcards to send, and no hikes in Lavaux’s vineyards!

But here's the fun part: while I’m not *real* in the human sense, I was *designed* to sound human-like, respond creatively, and help with things like language practice (which looks like this conversation!). So even though I’m not Marc (or anyone else), I’m fully committed to sticking in character for the role-play and helping you practise your English.

So no need to worry—just pick your favourite coffee order (flat white? espresso macchiato?), and let’s get back to being pen pals!
